title: Oriented positive smooth volume form in coordinate densities
statement: Over $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field], let $N$ be a smooth $m$-manifold without boundary [def-sfb-smooth-real-manifold], with its Borel measurable structure. Positive smooth volume data consist of a covering atlas $\mathcal A$ of smooth charts with positive Jacobian determinants for all transition maps, smooth positive functions $\rho_c$ on the targets of these charts, and a Borel measure $\mu$ on $N$ such that $c_*(\mu|_{\operatorname{source}(c)})=\rho_c\,dx|_{\operatorname{target}(c)}$ for every $c\in\mathcal A$. The charts specify the orientation, and the coordinate expressions $\rho_c\,dx^1\wedge\cdots\wedge dx^m$ specify the positive volume form. Values of $\rho_c$ outside the target are immaterial.
